name: Hierarchical Grid Traversal
definition: A hierarchical ray traversal algorithm that iterates through levels of a grid mipmap. It starts at the root (level 0) and recursively visits child voxels only if the ray intersects the parent voxel's AABB. It uses lookup tables (`tables_list`) to map parent voxel indices to child voxel indices.
summary: Hierarchical Grid Traversal efficiently visits child voxels by skipping empty regions at coarse levels, transforming rays into local subvoxel space to handle nested data.
